prompt:
Use aged paper, restrained sepia color, halftone print texture, and archival cutout framing.
Treat photographs and documents as tactile evidence layers with legible hierarchy.
Avoid: Glossy modern gradients, neon color, and playful preschool proportions.
Composition: Organize evidence in measured overlapping planes with one dominant archival focal point.
Composition: Preserve readable margins, captions, and document edges instead of filling every gap.
Create ONE COMPLETE 2x2 square registered animation sheet on genuine transparent alpha. Use the attached object as the immutable design reference. Top-left: BUD, closed ivory flower bud. Top-right: OPENING, the same petals partly unfolding around the same gold center. Bottom-left: BLOOM, fully open elegant flower. Keep stem, leaves, flower center, basal contact and scale absolutely identical in all three states. Bottom-right EMPTY transparent unused cell. Each quadrant has identical canvas coordinates. Object center x=50%, baseline y=88% of each cell. Keep 12% clear margins; no piece may cross a quadrant. No cell borders, labels or numbers. One elegant ivory cosmos-like paper flower on a thin continuous sepia stem with two small muted indigo leaves, warm gold center and 8 delicate layered ivory petals. Vintage botanical illustration printed on textured paper, complete silhouette, understated fine-art collage. No pot, soil or extra flowers. No text, logos, watermark, backdrop or baked checkerboard. Full object including stem or envelope edges visible; refined printed paper details.
